title: Canonical Zariski restriction and section transport data
statement: For a scheme $S$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], use the functor sending an open to its open-subscheme etale object. Restriction of an etale sheaf $F$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets] is precomposition by this functor, with the sheaf condition from continuity [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-etale-core]. For $i:Z\to X$ and $h:X\prime\to X$, put $Z\prime=Z\times_X X\prime$ and $i\prime=\mathrm{pr}_2$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. Define $G=(h^*F)|_{X\prime_{Zar}}$ and $H=(i\prime^*h^*F)|_{Z\prime_{Zar}}$, and the canonical preimage-open/base-change isomorphism using pullbackRestrictIsoRestrict and pullback symmetry. Define the top section lift using the top-open/identity and identity-pullback isomorphisms. Define the section isomorphism $H(Z\prime)\cong ((\mathrm{pr}_1\circ i)^*F)(Z\prime)$ by the same top-open identifications, the unit-compatible composition isomorphism [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], pullbackComp, and transport along pullback.condition. The target section is the inverse of this isomorphism applied to the pullback of $t$. Define the topological pullback and its unit by [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image]; a comparison is unit compatible when its value on that unit equals the etale unit transported through the canonical preimage-open isomorphism. On one open $W$ with $\phi:W\to U$ over $X$, the local representative is the etale unit of $s\in F(U)$ restricted along pullback.lift $\phi$ $W.\iota$. All data are actual constructions, with no arbitrary existence choices.

def gabberZariskiSectionIso {X Z X' : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) (h : X' ⟶ X)
    (F : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (Type (u + 1))) :
    (gabberZariskiSheaf (pullback i h)
      ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.snd i h)).obj
        ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback h).obj F))).obj.obj (op (⊤ : (pullback i h).Opens)) ≅
    ((Scheme.etaleSetPullback (pullback.fst i h ≫ i)).obj F).obj.obj
      (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ (pullback.fst i h ≫ i)).obj
        (Scheme.Etale.mk (𝟙 X))))
